synth.notes:
Floor colour 5; blocks 10 / armed players 1 / markers 9 inactive, 11 active on a 4px grid.
Block mode: A1/A2 both y-/+4, A3 left x-4 & right x+4, A4 reverse; each moves iff dest 4x4 all floor.
Click inactive marker arms (blocks->1, marker->11, old active->9); click armed player disarms; armed A1-4 move active marker cell iff dest 4x4 floor.
HUD: colour-0 bar width 3(a+1)//7 at row 0 right-aligned and row 63 left-aligned; a = actions this level, continuity-gated on frame equality, fallback smallest a for observed width.
Unconfirmed: A7 and level-completion behaviour (unobserved).
